# Creature Shader - reference maps (Mecha Lab 0.24.95)

Each map here is a 512 px placeholder made by `tools_dev/make_creature_maps.py`.  Make a high-resolution version of each (any size, 2048 px is good), keep the **same folder and file name** (`skin/skin_scales_l.png` ...; .jpg or .png), and send the folder back.

All maps are **greyscale** and must **tile seamlessly** (they repeat over the model).

## skin - Height maps of the skin - white raised, black deep

### `skin/skin_pores` - Human Pores (사람 모공)

Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048 x 2048, seen straight from above (orthographic), flat even lighting with no shadows, highlights or perspective, greyscale height map, white is raised and black is deep: human skin: fine pores and tiny creases, very subtle. Fills the whole square edge to edge and tiles perfectly on all four sides. No text, no border, no vignette.
